about_the_game:
The adventure begins when Capt. Gore Rapture and crew are called to the Planet Goatainn. The reason is that the evil on this planet is affecting the entire solar system. Their mission is to neutralize all foes on the once Glorious planet. The landing was rough, and the result was that Cpt. Rapture was knocked unconscious. The ship's co-pilot puts the Captain on a hypnotic schedule to recall all missions over time as he recovers! This Demo features the first level, a large, beautiful, and engaging one with many objectives. The enemies are diverse in skills and breed, with many around every corner. Enjoy the finest sci-fi weaponry that can dismember even the toughest of these evil folks. 

Gore Rapture ships with all the latest in-game technologies that can be turned off or on to scale to the system. This Demo features plenty of cool music and can be played in FPP or TPP modes. An enemy mini-map is optional and often available to assess your surroundings and who is around you! This Demo is the entire first level of the game.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains extreme violence, gore, and dismemberment. It may not be appropriate for most workplaces.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 3.2 GHz Quad-Core Processor
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1060 / Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 3.5 GHz Quad-Core Processor or higher
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1060 / Radeon RX 580 or Higher
